[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Russ Grimblade''' was one of the leaders of the [[Hidden Daggers]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Grimblade was a skilled pilot, last seen flying an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. He wore red and black colored [[Reinforced Insulated Sheath armor|R.I.S. armor]].

When the Hidden Daggers attacked more and more [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and even [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] pilots in the Corellian system in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], CorSec [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rhea]] ordered one of his pilots to take out their leaders. The pilot destroyed several Hidden Daggers starfighters until the pirates decided to send Grimblade to bring the CorSec pilot down. Grimblade engaged the pilot with his X-wing but was shot down and killed.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateHiddendaggerPilots.jpg|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of Russ Grimblade]]
Russ Grimblade appears in one of the duty missions for CorSec pilots in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', available from Sergeant Rhea in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]]. After killing several waves of pirates, one of the pirate leaders spawns and has to be killed by the player. Grimblade is the first of these leaders, followed by [[Xopw Laow]], [[Mori]] and [[Owpa Awoz]].
